name: Ruuzel
summary: Talen needs the Ring of Zoram to open an ancient statuette found on the strand. The naga have taken the ring to their island sanctuary.

sections.title: The Key of Zoram
sections.body: Talen believes the Ring of Zoram can open the ancient statuette recovered from the coast. Before the Great Sundering broke Kalimdor and sank its coastal cities, powerful night elven nobles ruled Zoram. The ring belonged among their regalia. After the cataclysm, it vanished beneath the waves for millennia, keeping the secrets of sunken relics from curious eyes.

sections.title: The Naga Incursion
sections.body: Naga have recently come to the Zoram Strand and begun searching the ruins of their former homeland. Ruuzel, who leads the local brood, found the Ring of Zoram and took it to her sanctuary on an island to the north. Talen, a night elf, asks Alliance travelers to hunt Ruuzel and reclaim the heirloom so he can open the statuette recovered from the shallows.

faq.answer: Ruuzel leads the naga on the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Her lair lies on an island offshore to the north, where she guards treasures recovered from the sunken night elf civilization.

faq.q: What is the Ring of Zoram?
faq.answer: The Ring of Zoram belonged to the ancient rulers of Zoram before the Sundering. Talen believes it can open the lock on an ancient statuette.

faq.q: Why does Talen need the ring?
faq.answer: Talen wants to uncover the secrets inside an ancient Kaldorei statuette recently recovered from the strand. He believes only the Ring of Zoram can turn its lock.

faq.q: Where did the city of Zoram go?
faq.answer: The Great Sundering destroyed the ancient Kaldorei city of Zoram ten thousand years ago. Most of its grand stonework sank into the Veiled Sea, leaving scattered ruins along the coast.
Ruuzel dwells on a large rocky island off the northern edge of the Zoram Strand, with her serpentine followers around her.

faq.q: What happens after retrieving the ring?
faq.answer: After you return the ring, Talen can finish his investigation on the strand. He rewards your aid and remembers your service.

angles.text: As a night elf, reclaiming the Ring of Zoram brings a piece of your ancestral heritage back from the naga desecrating your forebears' sunken ruins.
As an Alliance traveler, you help Talen blunt the naga threat pushing ashore along northern Ashenvale.
